correctness.rationale: For each span r, a fixed positive gap composition corresponds to exactly N-r subsets, proving conditional uniformity. A Pólya increment selects coordinate i with probability g_i/r; its incoming mass is constant for every composition at r+1, establishing all conditional marginals. The unnormalized vector grows coordinatewise while normalized proportions form a martingale; Jensen and scalar covariance comparison prove dual signs with stated strictness. Boundary cases k=2 and k=N are explicit. Exact adjacent-pair and quadratic concentration identities follow from uniform positive augmented gaps and the urn second moment. Standalone verifier passed 6527 exact assertions through N=11; no infinite proof depends on enumeration.

The same exact conditional coupling yields opposite stochastic dependencies for absolute short gaps and relative convex dispersion, simultaneously for every threshold and convex functional.
